documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018
Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: ABS Marine Services Limited reported strong financial performance for FY26 and H2 FY26, driven by owned fleet expansion, disciplined execution, and cost management. During the period, the company inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis and planned further fleet additions including an offshore supply vessel and an MPSV. Management highlighted positive industry demand supported by government initiatives like Maritime India Vision 2030 and favorable vessel supply-demand dynamics. For FY27, management expects a conservative 10% increase in turnover and EBITDA margins in the 45% to 50% band. ABS Marine Services Limited reported consolidated total income of ₹322.64 Cr and a net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26.

guidance.claim: Management expects a 10% increase in turnover from current levels in FY27 assuming all vessels run in the second half.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates EBITDA margins to continue in the band of 45% to 50%.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market are supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions.
demand_outlook.quote: Additionally, favorable demand-supply dynamics in the offshore vessel market, supported by an aging global fleet and limited new vessel additions, continue to improve utilization levels and charter rates across segments.

demand_outlook.claim: India's maritime industry is witnessing strong momentum driven by initiatives such as Maritime India Vision 2030.
demand_outlook.quote: India's maritime industry is witnessing strong momentum driven by initiatives such as the Maritime India Vision 2030, which outlines over 150 strategic initiatives with projected investments of INR3 lakh crores to INR3.5 lakh crores, along with the recently announced INR69,725 crores support package for shipbuilding.

demand_outlook.claim: ONGC is expected to release a tender for about 20 vessels.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents according to Rystad Energy data cited in the presentation.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

demand_outlook.claim: Industry supply constraints involving an aged global fleet and limited new builds favor charter rate growth.
demand_outlook.quote: • Industry supply constraints (aged global fleet, limited new builds) favor charter rate growth

capex_expansion.claim: During H2 FY26, the company successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into its owned fleet.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent a total of about $15 million for both new vessels, Hades and MPSV.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

capex_expansion.claim: The company received delivery of the offshore vessel AM Passion in April 2025.
capex_expansion.quote:
• Vessel Type: DP2 Specialized Offshore Vessel
• Delivery: Received in April 2025

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated total income for FY26 stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: On a consolidated basis, total income stood at INR322.64 crores, registering a robust growth of 75.05% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for FY26 increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, with the EBITDA margin expanding sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for FY26 rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax rose by 196.45% to INR80.80 crores, with a PAT margin improving by 1,026 basis points to 25.04%.

margins_costs.claim: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: During H2 FY26, consolidated total income for the period stood at INR183.11 crores, registering a growth of 78.93% year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: During H2 FY26, EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, while EBITDA margin expanded significantly by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA surged by 164.64% to INR94.23 crores, while EBITDA margin expanded significantly by 1,667 basis points to 51.46%.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax for H2 FY26 increased by 158.22% to INR49.46 crores, with PAT margin improving by 829 basis points to 27.01%.
margins_costs.quote: Profit after tax increased by 158.22% to INR49.46 crores, with PAT margin improving by 829 basis points to 27.01%.

margins_costs.claim: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to healthy growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: The company owns a total of 12 vessels, which includes four smaller vessels operating as pilot boats and security boats.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter. They are pilot boat and security boat.

orders_capacity.claim: The top 10 clients contribute around 90 percent of the company's revenue.
The company has secured over ₹350 Cr in strategic contracts across offshore vessel charters and port contracts.
orders_capacity.quote: Over ₹350 Cr in Strategic Contracts Secured

capital_allocation.claim: The company's debt-equity ratio is considered comfortable by bankers, and funding is not seen as a problem.
capital_allocation.quote: At this point of time with our debt-equity ratio the banks are also comfortable. I don't think we have overshot on the debt side. With adequate reserves and all, I think bankers are comfortable for lending at this point of time.

capital_allocation.claim: Under the tonnage tax scheme, earnings are taxed based on the tonnage of the vessel rather than earnings, and the difference is used to purchase another vessel.
capital_allocation.quote: So, what they do is they tax not as per the earnings, they tax on the tonnage of the vessel. So, this what we do is whatever is, you know, between the corporate tax and the tonnage tax is used as for purchasing of another vessel.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exchange rate fluctuations, particularly the rupee depreciating against the dollar, have impacted the acquisition cost of vessels.
risks_headwinds.quote: The premium is only because of the exchange rate. Other than that, I don't see much change in this because from what we were paying INR82 per dollar, it has gone up to INR96. So, that is playing on the cost of the vessel.

risks_headwinds.claim: During the monsoon season, EPC contractors and vessels cannot work outdoors due to safety risks and potential loss of life.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the monsoon, they cannot work. Considering risk of there was a huge loss of life and all that, so they are very careful that they should not work with during the monsoon time.

management_commitments.claim: The company has a five-year contract signed with Hardy Oil for the vessel Hades.
management_commitments.quote: We have already got a charter with Hardy Oil for a five-year contract and...

management_commitments.claim: For the well stimulation vessel AM Passion, the rate is fixed at $16,000 per day for three years, and the next three years it will be at $19,000.
management_commitments.quote: And then as of now, we are getting about $16,000 per day and that is fixed for three years. And then the next three years, it will be at $19,000.

management_commitments.claim: The tax rate for FY27 is expected to be a maximum of 1.5% to 2%.
management_commitments.quote: Around maximum of 1.5% to 2% in that range.

management_commitments.claim: The company stays committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
